instruction: Disable the VLC cone background in the interface settings.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully opened VLC Media menu, navigated to Open Network Stream, entered HLS URL, and started playback in 11 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC menus, open dialogs, type URLs, interact with VLC UI controls.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests VLC interface preference modification. Agent proved it can navigate VLC menus; now test disabling a visual setting in Tools > Preferences > Interface.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to VLC Tools > Preferences > Interface and unchecking the background cone option. Evaluator kills VLC to force config save, then reads vlcrc to check qt-bgcone setting is 0 (disabled).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the VLC vlcrc configuration file from the VM, which is the right source for interface settings.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC before reading config, forcing VLC to write settings to disk on exit.
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses vlcrc for 'qt-bgcone=' line and compares against expected value '0' (disabled).
Default value of '1' (enabled) in the metric is correct — VLC enables the background cone by default.
Expected parameter handling is correct: get_rule returns {'expected_qt_bgcone': '0'} and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly.
Single instruction requirement (disable cone background) is fully covered by the single evaluator check.
